'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Regis Michelena LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Regis Michelena]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Obi-Wan likes his women just a little on the trashy side
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
